question: The equivalent capacitance of the system shown in the following circuit is :
diagram_alt: A 3 μF capacitor from A in series with two 3 μF capacitors in parallel, ending at B
solution:
The two $3\ \mu$F capacitors on the right are in parallel: $3 + 3 = 6\ \mu$F.

This is in series with the $3\ \mu$F capacitor:
$$C = \frac{3 \times 6}{3 + 6} = 2\ \mu\text{F}$$
